newsitem.title: USA: Cisco affirms 30-50 pct mkt growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: Cisco affirms 30-50 pct mkt growth outlook.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc chief executive John Chambers remains confident the networking sector can grow by 30 to 50 percent this year.

"It's only a question of whether it's going to be (closer to) 30 percent or 50 percent. It isn't a question of whether it's going to be in that range," Chambers said after addressing an industry convention here.

Chambers, who was repeating earlier forecasts, said Cisco still aims to outperform the overall market's annual revenue growth. "We will try to overachieve beyond that...but we try to be realistic," he said.
Chambers noted that Cisco's stock fell earlier this week despite the company's release of financial results showing net sales soared 73 percent in the second quarter, which ended January 25.
Earnings, also up strongly, were roughly in line with Wall Street forecasts.
Referring to the growth as "awesome," Chambers jokingly said he asked himself, "What did I do wrong?" when the company's share price fell.
"It's a real nervous industry," he added.
In his speech, Chambers predicted an industry shakeout in the near future.
"You are going to see just a few large players a short time from now," he said.
Chambers said the industry is moving too fast for companies to go it alone.

"At times that means partnering with competitors," he said. "Those companies who do not learn how to do that ... will get left behind. Our industry's moving too fast for anyone doing it by themselves."
